rules.statement: A usufructuary mortgagee can assign their right to take the produce of a land in lieu of interest on the mortgage debt.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is quite true that if a man is indebted to me, and the debt carries interest, I may assign to others the debt and the interest separately. The right to take the produce of a land, subject to a mortgage in lieu of interest, is only a way of collecting the interest."
